agape_framework.summary: Autonomously identify gaps debt and corrective opportunities
Root decisions in deterministic environment and constraint probes
Degrade gracefully via fallback ladders when ideal paths fail
Select actionable routes through failure states and constraints
Validate outcomes with observable metrics and reproducible checks

agape_rules.title: No Sentimental Criteria
agape_rules.summary: Acceptance and validation MUST use technical evidence rather than affective wording

agape_rules.title: Fallback First
agape_rules.summary: All critical paths require survivable fallback behavior on constrained hosts

agape_rules.title: Actionable Learning
agape_rules.summary: System output MUST teach through concrete next steps and traceable rationale
